name: Plugin Guard
author: Matt Wolfgang
description: Security-check Omarchy plugins before installing or updating them, with static checks plus a review by a local model or the Claude, Codex, or Grok CLI. After installing, press Run setup in the widget (or run its install.sh) once for full functionality: the plugin-guard command, and checks on typed omarchy plugin add and update before they install. Versions before 1.0.3 could install a plugin but leave it disabled; enable it with omarchy plugin enable.

barWidget.description: Scan a plugin before installing it, pick the review model, and see the scan status of installed plugins

schema.label: Check plugins installed or changed outside Plugin Guard in the background (reviews them with the selected model, and disables any rated dangerous)
